instruction: Configure Chrome so that all web pages are translated to Spanish automatically, skipping the translation prompt.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a setting to automatically translate all pages to a specific language without user interaction. Chrome can offer to translate pages, but cannot be configured to translate automatically without prompts.
